errors.text: The proposed boron microalloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of adding 4.2 at.% Cr to HfMoTaTiZr.
No specific starting composition, boron concentration, processing route, or quantitative density constraint is provided.

The proposed mechanism involving boride precipitation and grain-boundary strengthening differs from the target combination of Cr-induced solid-solution hardening and crack hindrance by a reticulated Laves phase.
No prior-study evidence or citations support the hypothesis.
The experiment does not test preservation of room-temperature strength or ductility, nor does it measure density, so it cannot establish the full claimed benefit.
